{{Top|leg}}
'''''Red''''' were a pair of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] used by a civilian organization. Both were scanned by a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] which identified their cargo as "Crew". The ships were allowed to enter [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] without incident.
